title: A recall key links a safety notice to reported repair progress while exposure and consumer restoration remain unresolved
source_unit: CPSC recall API notice and Monthly Progress Report row joined by recall key 23-090

observations.period: 2023-01-12 recall notice; Honda Talon 1000 recreational off-highway vehicles

denominator.unit: approximately units described in the official notice; not unique purchasers

reported_crash_with_minor_injuries.unit: reported crash with minor occupant injuries

repair_remedy_offered.unit: free dealer inspection and repair route

known_purchaser_contact_claimed.unit: manufacturer states it is contacting all known purchasers

observations.method: Read the official CPSC recall API record for recall key 23090/23-090 and retain date, product scale, hazard, incident signal, remedy, and contact language.
observations.uncertainty: The notice count is approximate product scale, not exposed households or purchaser risk; incident reports are not an incidence estimate and direct-contact language is not proof of notice receipt.
observations.subgroup: Honda Talon 1000 ROVs sold through authorized Honda Powersports dealers from March 2019 through September 2022.
observations.counterinterpretation: A recall notice and offered repair do not establish that every listed unit was used, defective under the same conditions, noticed, repaired, or safely restored.

denominator.unit: products recalled in the MPR row; not reconciled to the API notice scale

consumer_corrected.unit: firm-reported cumulative products corrected at consumer level

consumer_percent_reported.unit: percent reported consumer-level correction; MPR consumer-held denominator

observations.method: Select the MPR row with press-release number 23-090 and preserve manufacturer, distributor, retailer, consumer, total, and percentage fields.
observations.uncertainty: MPR fields are firm-reported cumulative progress; the MPR consumer-level percentage uses a consumer-held denominator that can differ from products recalled, and correction is not verified repair receipt or safe restoration.
observations.subgroup: Recall-keyed MPR implementation row for Honda Talon 1000 ROVs.
observations.counterinterpretation: The reported correction count may represent products rather than unique purchasers, and the MPR denominator may reflect a different scope or reporting population than the API notice.

denominator.unit: API approximate-unit field used only to frame the cross-source mismatch

mpr_minus_api_approximate_units.unit: products; 2,047 MPR minus approximately 34,000 API units

mpr_as_share_of_api_approximate_units.unit: percent; arithmetic comparison, not an exposure or completion rate

observations.method: Compare the two source-reported scale fields while preserving CPSC's note that consumer-level percentages use a consumer-held denominator that can differ from total recalled products.
observations.uncertainty: The mismatch may reflect recall expansion, scope, product, reporting-window, or denominator definitions; it cannot be resolved into purchaser exposure, notice reach, repair receipt, or household safety from these compact artifacts.
observations.subgroup: Same recall key across official API notice and MPR implementation row.
observations.counterinterpretation: The fields may be valid for different operational populations; treating the difference as missing consumers or failed repairs would be unsupported.

related_sources.claim: Retained MPR schema and recall-key row.
Recall-key implementation boundary and consumer-recovery limits.

boundary: This is a product-level implementation bridge, not a consumer-level recovery estimate. It does not establish purchaser exposure, notice receipt, completed repair, safe restoration, residual cost, trust, switching, or exit; the API and MPR denominators differ.
